Both changes are stored, but I made an error along the way that I've now fixed.

**What changed:**
- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20` in `theme.assistedModeColors.primary`. The portal is in assisted mode, so I changed the colour there rather than in `colors.primary`. On save the portal recalculates the palettes from this value, so it will overwrite any hand-set colours. `colors.primary` still reads `#1976D2` in the stored document until that recalculation runs.
- **Menu:** added "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (the generic page with slug `jeunesse`) as the last item, after Accueil and Catalogue de données.

**The error:** my first theme patch put the top-level keys (header, navBar, footer, datasets, and so on) inside `theme` by mistake. I rewrote the whole document, which restored them to the top level and kept `theme` to its original keys. I then re-read the document: `theme` is clean and the top level has the same 23 keys as before.

**Not verified:** I haven't checked how the portal renders the new colour or menu entry, since I only have the document API.
